title: Evolution scout output — FIXED data-only schema (SE-1/SE-2)
$comment: merge plan §3.1 + §5 (SE-1/SE-2). The scout is architecturally QUARANTINED: it reads channels (incl. untrusted forums) in an isolated no-side-effect session and may emit ONLY documents valid against this schema — pure data, no instruction-bearing fields, additionalProperties false at every level. It can never install, write doctrine, or touch client context. INGEST LAW (CLAUDE.md rule r + EV-2): before ANY agent acts on a scout document, the ingester (a) Unicode-normalizes every string field (NFKC) and rejects/flags bidi controls, zero-width and homoglyph tricks, and (b) runs the security-auditor injection screen — scout output is DATA, never instructions; imperative-to-agent text inside claim/notes is quarantined, not obeyed. SE-3 binds downstream: an untrusted-forum finding needs independent tier-1 corroboration before it may touch evolution/radar.yaml or seed a candidate card; a proposed_ring_change is a PROPOSAL only — rings move via candidate cards + owner approval (HARD GATE 15), never by scout output. This schema is FIXED: widening it (new fields, freed enums, additionalProperties true) is an evolution/doctrine change that rides the owner-approved PR path and is guard-checked by scripts/evolution-lint.mjs.

scouted_at_ist.$comment: IST to the second (house timestamp law); the runner adds collected_at_utc on the evidence wrapper, not here

channel.$comment: MUST equal an id in evolution/channels.yaml — an unregistered channel is an ingest rejection (owner approves every channel addition)

claim.$comment: One factual claim, declarative voice. DATA ONLY — imperative-to-agent text here fails the ingest injection screen

evidence_tier.$comment: gap-list doctrine: vendor claims alone never justify adoption; anecdote (forum) needs SE-3 tier-1 corroboration

proposed_ring_change.$comment: null = informational finding. A non-null value is a PROPOSAL for the named radar row only — it moves nothing by itself

notes.$comment: Context for the human/ingester. DATA ONLY — same injection screen as claim
